programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Vacation Deluxe
programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive?

programme.title: Prefab Houses
programme.desc: A construction site in Sigmaringendorf, Swabia. But a special one: A prefabricated house is to be built here in just 2 days. The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo and his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo and takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: Rob the Robot
programme.desc: Join Rob and his friends for an adventure with a knight, a lord and a lost dinosaur! The crew travels to the Medieval Planet to be knights for a day. Orbit volunteers to be their king, but soon realizes it's not so easy being the boss! Then, after finishing their favorite storybook, the gang travels to the Story Planet to live out their own epic adventure! Finally, when Rob can't find his favorite stuffed dinosaur, the friends decide to travel to the Prize Planet to win him a new one.

programme.title: Rob the Robot

Then, when Ema feels down about being different from her robot pals, they go to the Spare Parts Planet. Finally, when Orbit accidentally paints himself pink, the crew travels to the Paint Planet to fix it.

programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes has heard reports of a dog being beaten in broad daylight and Animal Welfare Officer John Littlewood has found CCTV to back up the claim. The police agree that the dog is clearly suffering and they go in convoy with Anthony to visit the dogs owner but he isn't going to let his dog Millie go without a fight.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has a heavyweight problem to tackle -V Kifarou, one of Flamingoland's male white rhinos, has a skin infection. At Matt's surgery, he operates on a kestrel with a broken wing. When wildlife rescuer Jean Thorpe arrives to collect the patient, Matt has another bundle for her, a poorly duck with suspected lead poisoning.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester shockingly injured Saluki Susie limps onto a petrol station forecourt and into Inspector Becky Goulding's life. Susie's found with football socks tied tightly around her legs. One fractured leg is damaged beyond repair and has to be removed. After Susie's sad start will she find her happy ending?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. But a lack of food isn't all that's wrong, there are scars on his face and body that suggest he's been through a hard youth. To try and piece together the dog's history Joe needs all the information he can gather.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: There's excitement as the first baby giraffe to be born at Flamingoland is due at any moment. Can Dr. Matt ensure a safe delivery? And a young male rhino needs a medical MOT before he can meet some females but he just won't co-operate. Meanwhile a macaw with a twisted beak presents Matt with a bit of a challenge.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: Scruffts

And a young male rhino needs a medical MOT before he can meet some females but he just won't co-operate. Meanwhile a macaw with a twisted beak presents Matt with a bit of a challenge.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove make Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs
programme.desc: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove go head-to-head as they attempt to recreate our Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs. We dive into their love for animals, the history of their friendship, and even talk tasty treats...but only one will win the tiny trophy!

programme.title: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa make Tiny Pumpkin Pie
programme.desc: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa bring in the fall festivities as well as the Halloween horror as they recreate our Tiny Pumpkin Pie. They discuss scream queens, and love scenes, and get very competitive when it comes to perfect pie - winner takes fall!

programme.title: Lucy Lawless & Renee O'Connor Make Tiny Chili Cheese Nachos
programme.desc: It’s a battle for the ages as Lucy Lawless & Renee O’Connor reunite from their warrior princess days to recreate Tiny Chili Cheese Nachos. They talk stunts & metal bras and some smoke ensues - but only one will burn the competition to the ground.

programme.title: Paul Scheer & Rob Huebel Make Tiny Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Rob Huebel & Paul Scheer put their cooking chops to the test as they attempt to recreate our Tiny Carrot Cake. Rob fancies himself a silver fox and Paul talks about his Trekkie days, but only one will take the tiny trophy in this comedic food fight.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: Farmer's Market Finds
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith heads to the Farmers Market for the first time. Inspired by rows of fresh fruit, veggies and the local farmers he creates a flavorful meal like Veggie Focaccia, Mushroom Medley Pasta, Spiced Apple Cobbler and a crisp white Sangria.

programme.title: Cheesin'
programme.desc: Cheese can be really expensive. Frankie teaches us how to cook with more affordable cheese swaps, and we learn how to stretch cheese in a dish so it can be the star without breaking the bank. Bonus: Frankie teaches how to make cheese at home!

programme.title: Turn Up For Tomatoes
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to prepare tomatoes fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve them so you can enjoy their freshness throughout the year.

programme.title: Holiday Flavors
programme.desc: The holiday season looks different this year, so why not mix things up and celebrate classic flavors in new and unexpected ways. Frankie teaches us to put a twist on all your holiday favorites, using simple ingredients for your loved ones to enjoy.

programme.title: Less Stress Holidays
programme.desc: The holidays are hectic enough, and with more planning, cooking and cleaning than usual, everyone wants to shop smart and save time. Frankie tackles weekday meals that will keep you organized, fed, and less stressed this season.

programme.title: The Count of Monte Cristo goes to Cuba
programme.desc: Chef Jason merges two iconic sandwiches into a super, savory powerhouse of flavors! Meet the Monte Cristo Cubano, complete with slow-roasted, mojo pork, country ham, and swiss cheese that is battered & deep-fried to perfection.

programme.title: Beef & Broccoli and Veggie Fried Rice: Chinese Takeout Staples
programme.desc: We’re having takeout tonight! Chef Shirley brings your favorite Chinese take-out classics straight to your kitchen! Just for you, she’s cooking up mouthwatering, Beef and Broccoli with Black Pepper Sauce, a fan favorite, and Veggie Fried Rice.

programme.title: Party for Pennies
programme.desc: Frankie makes three dishes for a party of four, that when combined, are cheaper than just one meal out for brunch. Then, it's a taco party for five people for only $20!

programme.title: Instant Gratification
programme.desc: Everyone loves carbs! Endlessly versatile, cheap, and super filling - Frankie shows you tricks for pasta, pizza dough, and delicious, easy ramen meals that aren't soup.

programme.title: All About the Apps
programme.desc: Who needs a main meal when you can fill up on appetizers? From cauliflower fritters, to chicken wings, to tiny taquitos we're starting this party off right!

programme.title: Grilled to Great
programme.desc: Fire up the grill because we've got some great grub for you! We're making grilled pork belly, spicy chicken tacos, and gooey grilled cheese kabobs.

programme.title: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove make Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs
programme.desc: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove go head-to-head as they attempt to recreate our Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs. We dive into their love for animals, the history of their friendship, and even talk tasty treats...but only one will win the tiny trophy!

programme.title: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa make Tiny Pumpkin Pie
programme.desc: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa bring in the fall festivities as well as the Halloween horror as they recreate our Tiny Pumpkin Pie. They discuss scream queens, and love scenes, and get very competitive when it comes to perfect pie - winner takes fall!

programme.title: Tori Spelling & Teddi Mellencamp make Tiny French Toast with Homemade Strawberry Syrup
programme.desc: Don’t miss the Beverly Hills ladies who brunch as Tori Spelling & Teddi Mellencamp make Tiny French Toast with Homemade Strawberry Syrup. They spill the tea on having famous fathers and candy cravings...but who’s toast will be trophy-worthy?

programme.title: Ryan Hansen & Jimmy O. Yang make Tiny Cake Pops
programme.desc: Monica’s bestie Ryan Hansen & his bud Jimmy O. Yang take their friendship to the next level by making Tiny Cake Pops. Jimmy gives us the scoop on how he spent his early paychecks and Ryan talks dancing and Dax...but only 1 will take the tiny cake!

programme.title: Empanadas For Everyone
programme.desc: Taco Night is no joke at Chef Eduardo’s Montana home, but here's a secret - he doesn’t always make tacos! Start a new trend with his Green Chile and Crab Empanadas, Pickled Charred Red Onions and a refreshing Avocado and Pico Salad and Lime Crema.

programme.title: New School Goulash and Spaetzle
programme.desc: Class is in session as Chef Tiffany takes us back in time and recreates a recipe that she perfected when she went back to school - Hungarian Goulash topped with a bright Dill Cream. On the side, a childhood favorite, crispy yet tender Spaetzle.

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

programme.title: Cauliflower's Star Power
programme.desc: Cauliflower is a star and can be transformed into unexpected dishes. Plus it's delicious and nutritious! Frankie reminds us to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

programme.title: Go For Game Day
programme.desc: When gathering to watch the game, it's important that everyone be chewing while they cheer! From peel-and-eat shrimp, to a jalapeno burger dog, and inside out nachos, we've got something for every fan.

programme.title: The Perfect Pairing
programme.desc: What’s better than your two favorite things coming together for the best bite ever? With pizza waffles, french fry corn dogs, and a pasta frittata, these dynamic duos will not disappoint.

programme.title: Erin O’Brien’s Pork My Buns XXXX
programme.desc: Artist and activist, Erin O’Brien, grinds up some homemade sausages and chats about using food as performance art. She and Ingrid stuff up her Pork My Buns XXXX to honor her friend Chris’s progressive work as a trans filmmaker.

programme.title: Parisa Parnian’s Ghormeh Sabzi
programme.desc: Designer and pop-up host, Parisa Parnian of Savage Muse, stirs up ghormeh sabzi and celebrates her LGTBQIA+ inclusive pop ups. She and Ingrid simmer this traditional Iranian dish as they discuss the importance of building your own community.

programme.title: Mac Elliot Jarvis’ Shakshuka
programme.desc: Chef Mac Elliot Jarvis serves up shakshuka and speaks about the kitchen being a safe space. He and Ingrid cook comfort food and chat about him using cooking to find confidence in transitioning.

programme.title: Jeff Danzer’s Cana-Caramel Apples
programme.desc: Cannabis advocate and chef, Jeff Danzer aka JeffThe420Chef, craves up caramel apple roses and chats about cannabis right. He and Ingrid roll up puff pastry and pontificate on the linked history of cannabis and gay rights.

programme.title: Chef Carter’s Philly Cheesesteaks & Crab Fries
programme.desc: Event curator and entrepreneur, Chef Carter, chops up cheesesteaks and chats about creating female friendly experiences in LA. She and Ingrid cut up this classic sandwich and celebrate being a strong woman in a restaurant.

programme.title: Michael Twitty’s Smoked Tea Greens

programme.desc: Inspired by years spent as a yacht chef and traveling the world, Chef Eduardo invokes his memories from his time spent in Turkey, as he grills up mouthwatering Lamb Kabob and whips up an easy Shepherd's Salad.

programme.desc: Versatility is important. These three items - bacon, eggs, and a whole chicken - will feed you a plethora of delicious meals... and for cheap!

programme.title: Beer-Based Plates
programme.desc: Three cheers for these fabulous fixins which all have a little bit o’ beer in them. We’ve got beer-battered fish tacos, beer & cheese soup, black beer chicken, and more. Now ‘hop’ to it and get cookin’.

programme.title: A New Frontier
programme.desc: You don't need a lot of space to grow your own produce & you can use natural elements to create healing products for the body. Also, our most bizarre one-of-a-kind magnum opus - it's a new frontier.

programme.title: Party Tricks
programme.desc: Laura's got tricks up her sleeve. First, she enlists some help to make kombucha's cousin, kompot. Next, it's feel good treats for your pup. And finally - a yacht party! But not that kind - we mean the band YACHT! Enjoy.

programme.title: The Great Outdoors
programme.desc: Laura teams up with Mia & Pascal for a foraging adventure and outdoor meal. Then, we learn which veggies and spices make the best dyes. Finally, you can never have too many tomatoes! Soup, salad and a perfect Bloody Mary blend are in your future.

programme.title: Fab Friends
programme.desc: Surprise! Laura is equally crafty when it comes to woodwork. Then, fabulous recipes & a backyard brunch to knock your friend's socks off! Finally, Laura visits ceramicist Georgia Hodges at her studio in SF, and together, they create a unique piece.

programme.title: One Tray Bake and Hangry Hacks

programme.desc: Frankie explores the historic cities of Bologna, Genoa and Rome while he stuffs his face — Italian style.

programme.title: Gunarolla's Lunar New Year
programme.desc: Andrew Gunadie aka Gunarolla heads to Southeast Asia for Luna New Year, and travel photographer Lily Rose checks in at a once-in-a-lifetime beach resort in Bora Bora.

programme.title: Julie's Adventures in Mexico
programme.desc: Julie heads South of the border to face her fear of heights in Tulum, take in some waves in Ensenada, and participate in Día de los Muertos in Mexico City.

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ.

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Joys of Jamaican Cooking
programme.desc: Stephanie challenges herself to learn more about Caribbean food. Meeting with home cook Kat Williams, who teaches her about Jerk chicken and the art of rice and peas and then restaurant owner Chef Tony who shows her the secret to oxtail.

programme.title: Middle East Street Food Eats
programme.desc: Stephanie highlights the diversity of Middle Eastern cuisine through the lens of street food. Cooking Pakistani kebabs with home chef, Izza Khan, and then learning the complexity of Israeli street food at Dr. Sandwich.

programme.title: Stephanie and the Pitmaster
programme.desc: Stephanie joins UPS driver and home chef, Fernando Carrillo, for a backyard BBQ and a trip to LA institution Carnitas el Momo to learn the subtle art of slow cooking and the techniques of flavor.

programme.title: Legacies and Thai Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Key Ingredients of West African Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie meets Nigerian chefs, Eros and JP, to learn the basics of cooking West African cuisine. From palm oil to locust beans to asaro; Stephanie tests her knowledge and her skills - using these unfamiliar ingredients.

programme.title: Amsterdam & Paris
programme.desc: Amsterdam is a city unlike any other. As the capital of the Netherlands, it’s home to a plethora of historic sights and culinary delights. Known as The City of Light, Paris can feel anchored in another time, while a dynamic food scene keeps evolving.

programme.title: Dublin & Copenhagen

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E04 - Juggled Lives
programme.desc: La ajetreada agenda del Dr. AJ Wheeler le mantiene fuera de combate, pero su equipo lucha contra los fuertes vientos en el helicóptero para salvar a un conductor de motos de nieve con el fémur roto. Luego recibe otra llamada y el Dr. Wheeler está allí, intentando rescatar a un hombre que cae por un acantilado de 60 metros.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E01 - Antler Raiders
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛試圖控制人群，當大門打開時，角獅獵人被釋放以尋找他們的獎杯。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E02 - Across The Seeded Fields
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲護理員在第一天的雞頭鷂季節出動，密切監視合規與不合規的狩獵行為，確保播種田地不受損害。.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E03 - Breaking Terry Badly
programme.desc: 特里在《絕命毒師》中成為沃爾特·懷特的犧牲品，特里和拉里測試這部標誌性系列的3個獨立場景，其中兩個需要特效專家安德烈·艾林森的幫助，包括點燃一個氣罐和通過一扇鋼門進行化學燃燒。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E04 - Larry's Shadow
programme.desc: 拉里被特里的黑暗和神秘世界吸引，因為特里想測試1994年與亞歷克·鮑德溫一起拍攝的電影《暗影》的兩個場景。特里將發現他們是否能拯救一個被水泥鞋困住的男人，然後他們將進行一個看似不可能的測試。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Las estrellas son un poco como los seres humanos. Pueden ser cálidas o frías, tienen todo tipo de formas y tamaños... y, admitámoslo, pueden ser tenues o brillantes. Según recientes descubrimientos, sólo en nuestra galaxia, la Vía Láctea, hay más de 200.000 millones de estrellas. ¿Qué son estos ciudadanos del cielo nocturno?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E03 - Married to the Job
programme.desc: Jake y Marilynn cancelan una cena para poder atender a un esquiador herido en Teton Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E04 - Juggled Lives
programme.desc: La ajetreada agenda del Dr. AJ Wheeler le mantiene fuera de combate, pero su equipo lucha contra los fuertes vientos en el helicóptero para salvar a un conductor de motos de nieve con el fémur roto. programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E04 - Litica

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: La balsa sigue causando problemas mientras Chris y Casey gastan valiosas energías intentando mantenerse a flote. Con sus días en el Pacífico Sur menguando, los hermanos han llegado a su punto de ruptura'hasta que un nuevo descubrimiento deja un impacto duradero.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris y Casey han atravesado Nueva Zelanda a pie durante semanas. Luchar por sus vidas ha hecho mella en sus emociones y habilidades. Se asocian para cazar jabalíes, pero los alijos utilizados para sobrevivir crean nuevos retos y profundas frustraciones.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E05 - Getting to Know Rick O'Shea
programme.desc: 在這一集中，我們認識到拉里朋友Rick O'Shea（Ricochet）。Terry和Larry測試了幾部不同的電影，其中子彈被操縱以獲得驚人的效果。他們測試了來自Skyfall、自殺小隊、美國超人和《熊》的場景。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E06 - We Hear Ya!
programme.desc: 拉里和特里測試觀眾的多個請求。他們將測試來自《壞男孩2》、《危機警報》、《許可殺戮》和《曼谷危機》的瘋狂場景。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space

programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E05 - In The Drink
programme.desc: Los guardabosques de Montana manejan una variedad de problemas relacionados con el agua, como la basura, el consumo de alcohol por menores y el anualmente Yellowstone Boat Float. Su trabajo asegura la seguridad y la conservación de las vías fluviales de Montana, abordando las preocupaciones que surgen de las actividades recreativas durante las temporadas altas.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E06 - Warrants and Weed
programme.desc: 遊戲看守者經常必須處理不斷違規或有未解決逮捕令的人，這可能使他們接近時的情況變得複雜。.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer deben esforzarse para llegar a la zona de aterrizaje con una balsa que falla. Con sólo unas pocas horas antes de la extracción, ¿podrá la Madre Naturaleza sacar lo mejor de ellos antes de que puedan ponerse a salvo?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E07 - D-Day By Air
programme.desc: 特里回到跳傘學校，將看到對士兵而言，在D日以跳伞方式安全降落時，與敵人交戰是多麼困難。他將試著用3種不同的武器在空中下降時，擊中幾個目標。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E08 - Saving Private Terry
programme.desc: Terry有機會透過嘗試《拯救大兵瑞恩》中著名的狙擊手射擊來重溫他軍旅生涯的一部分，Larry和Terry演示了狙擊手技術如何隨著時間推移而發展，並測試一些驚人的狙擊手射擊。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: Las últimas actualizaciones sobre El nuevo hardware espacial a punto de lanzarnos a la próxima generación de vuelos espaciales algunos cohetes y cápsulas llegan a tiempo otros no tienen tanta suerte.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: La EXO Mars y el Curiosity continúan sus descubrimientos científicos mientras se preparan las nuevas misiones, tanto robóticas como tripuladas, al planeta rojo Marte.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E01 - Survival Mode
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer reflexionan sobre algunos de los mejores momentos de las dos primeras temporadas de Dropped. Los temas incluyen las cacerías individuales más memorables de los hermanos y cómo Dropped ha evolucionado a lo largo de los años.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E02 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Con el campamento base montado y el frío arreciando, Chris y Casey deben encontrar comida... rápido. Sus niveles de energía se están agotando a medida que comienzan su caza de alces. A medida que pasa el tiempo, los hermanos deben pensar bien para encontrar comida... o arriesgarse a pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy localiza algunos ciervos de cola blanca y centra sus esfuerzos en cazarlos.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving
programme.desc: Abastecidos de comida, Laramy y Siete prosperan en su nueva ubicación. Laramy se centra en la construcción de algunos servicios para hacer la vida más fácil en El Camino.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete se despiden de su último campamento y regresan a casa.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: Mientras practica senderismo en solitario en las profundidades del Parque Nacional de los Glaciares, Ted Porter se precipita por una grieta glaciar. Con la espalda rota y a kilómetros de cualquier persona, debe luchar para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Los cazadores Adrian Knopps y Garrett Hagen se aventuran en la parte más remota del fiordo Misty de Alaska, cazando alces y osos. Tras una exitosa cacería, Adrian se ve atrapado por una marejada de seis metros después de que Garrett no regrese con el esquife.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: Tras una exitosa cacería, el compañero de caza de Adrian Knopps desaparece llevándose el oso al barco. Ahora Adrian se encuentra varado en una llanura rodeado de osos y manadas de lobos y con una enorme tormenta que se cierne sobre él. ¿Cómo sobrevivirá?

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: El pastor Mike Turner está haciendo una excursión en solitario a través de la divisoria continental en la implacable cordillera Wind Rivers de Wyoming cuando queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca. En su diario relata su agotadora lucha de 11 días por sobrevivir.

Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: Mientras practica senderismo en solitario en las profundidades del Parque Nacional de los Glaciares, Ted Porter se precipita por una grieta glaciar. Con la espalda rota y a kilómetros de cualquier persona, debe luchar para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Los cazadores Adrian Knopps y Garrett Hagen se aventuran en la parte más remota del fiordo Misty de Alaska, cazando alces y osos. Tras una exitosa cacería, Adrian se ve atrapado por una marejada de seis metros después de que Garrett no regrese con el esquife.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: Tras una exitosa cacería, el compañero de caza de Adrian Knopps desaparece llevándose el oso al barco. Ahora Adrian se encuentra varado en una llanura rodeado de osos y manadas de lobos y con una enorme tormenta que se cierne sobre él. ¿Cómo sobrevivirá?

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: El pastor Mike Turner está haciendo una excursión en solitario a través de la divisoria continental en la implacable cordillera Wind Rivers de Wyoming cuando queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca. En su diario relata su agotadora lucha de 11 días por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer deben esforzarse para llegar a la zona de aterrizaje con una balsa que falla. Con sólo unas pocas horas antes de la extracción, ¿podrá la Madre Naturaleza sacar lo mejor de ellos antes de que puedan ponerse a salvo?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E01 - Survival Mode
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer reflexionan sobre algunos de los mejores momentos de las dos primeras temporadas de Dropped. Los temas incluyen las cacerías individuales más memorables de los hermanos y cómo Dropped ha evolucionado a lo largo de los años.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E02 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Con el campamento base montado y el frío arreciando, Chris y Casey deben encontrar comida... rápido. Sus niveles de energía se están agotando a medida que comienzan su caza de alces. A medida que pasa el tiempo, los hermanos deben pensar bien para encontrar comida... o arriesgarse a pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy localiza algunos ciervos de cola blanca y centra sus esfuerzos en cazarlos.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving
programme.desc: Abastecidos de comida, Laramy y Siete prosperan en su nueva ubicación. Laramy se centra en la construcción de algunos servicios para hacer la vida más fácil en El Camino.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete se despiden de su último campamento y regresan a casa.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.desc: 特里和拉里將測試丹佐·華盛頓的《平衡者》電影中的三個場景。特里能否像丹佐一樣酷，利用丙烷罐和微波爐創造爆炸，使用釘槍消滅壞人，或獲得閃光彈點燃滿是烘焙產品的房間？.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: El envío de sondas a través del sistema solar es el sueño de los matemáticos y la pesadilla de los ingenieros, que lanzan sondas alrededor de otros planetas para llegar a su destino.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: "Special Operations" are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: A medida que la guerra ha ido evolucionando, muchas técnicas y tecnologías militares han sido adaptadas para su uso en entornos urbanos por unidades policiales de todo el mundo. Este episodio ofrece a los espectadores una perspectiva íntima de lo que se siente al estar "dentro de las cabezas" del personal especial de la policía, y de cómo su uso de estrategias y equipos de estilo militar les permite salvar vidas. Desde el control de disturbios en Sudáfrica y las lecciones aprendidas de sus excesos, hasta la creación por parte del jefe de policía de Los Ángeles, Robert Gates, de un equipo policial de élite S.W.A.T., CQB mostrará cómo, en los últimos 30 años, la lucha contra la delincuencia urbana ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en un escenario militar, en el que ambos bandos utilizan armamento y tácticas cada vez más complejos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E09 - Mercy Kill
programme.desc: 守望者坎比克調查一頭麋鹿受傷的情況，以及試圖妥善處理這件事的獵人。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E10 - Tangled
programme.desc: 一隻受傷的鹿與另一隻雄鹿的角鎖住了，為守衛布朗斯創造了一個困境。.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E03 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: 特瑞和拉利測試他們在電影中看到的消音槍聲的方式。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E04 - Meet the Smiths
programme.desc: 男孩們測試了電影《史密斯夫婦》中的各種場景。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E07 - Living Planet
programme.desc: Gracias a la observación continua de la Tierra desde la órbita, los científicos han ido recopilando a lo largo del tiempo una serie de datos que revelan muchas cosas sobre cómo respira la Tierra y cómo se sustenta la vida en este Planeta vivo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E08 - Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Cosmic and x rays, these mysterious and highly powerful particles from deep space are being investigated to finally discover where they come from.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: Tras la caída de la Unión Soviética, muchos países siguieron en disputa a principios de los noventa, a pesar de la independencia de Europa del Este. En 1994 estalló un amargo conflicto entre las fuerzas del movimiento independentista checheno y el ejército regular ruso. A pesar de la abrumadora cantidad de efectivos, armamento y apoyo aéreo, las fuerzas rusas fueron incapaces de establecer un control permanente efectivo sobre la zona montañosa debido a las numerosas y exitosas incursiones de la guerrilla chechena. Los artefactos explosivos improvisados fueron uno de los métodos más eficaces empleados en estas desastrosas incursiones y fueron el telón de fondo de muchos escenarios de batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiadas entre ambos bandos.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: La historia del legado colonial del Imperio Británico en Irlanda del Norte es bien conocida en todo el mundo, pero hay una historia en gran parte no contada de los tiroteos entre y batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiados entre el IRA provisional, el ejército británico y el SAS de élite. Aunque el IRA empleó a menudo técnicas "terroristas" dentro de la ciudad de Londres y en el territorio continental de Inglaterra, no se habla mucho de las técnicas de guerra de guerrillas del Servicio Aéreo Especial británico en Irlanda del Norte desde el comienzo de este conflicto. En este episodio examinaremos cómo la historia del Servicio Aéreo Especial afectó a la formación de todas las fuerzas de élite posteriores y cómo las batallas cuerpo a cuerpo en Irlanda del Norte a finales de la década de 1970 hasta el milenio dieron forma tanto a las fuerzas especiales como a los métodos de resistencia.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
